Hello Mr Tim,

Here is the important information about your stay with us:

*Building Name:* Upper Crest by Damac
*Link:* https://maps.app.goo.gl/u5JDYQeN5ANMtge47

*Apartment No: 2605, 26th Floor*

*Door Code:* The access card is inside the box in front of the door. To open the box, simply pull the cover as our team has already left it open. If a code is requested, please use 8080, as shown in the picture.

*WiFi Name:* X28P-2.4G-8759BC
*WiFi Password:* 4462B425

*Facilities:* Gym and pool are located on the 6th floor

Upon arrival, kindly proceed to the reception for a smooth check-in. After collecting the access card from the box, please visit the reception again to activate it for the duration of your stay.
